sources.ref: NTA, JEE (Main) 2026 Session 2, B.E./B.Tech question paper 'B Tech 2nd Apr 2026 Shift 1' (English)

notes: Figures of ingested previous-year questions, to be recreated as diagrams through visual-director (never scanned). Each brief describes the official figure; labels are placed at anchors once an image exists.

requests.brief: two wire shapes side by side on white, thin dark lines. Left shape: a hairpin made of two long parallel horizontal straight wires extending far to the left (dashed at their far ends) joined on the right by a semicircular arc; a small dot at the centre of the arc with a short radius line to the arc. Right shape: one long horizontal straight wire coming in from the far left (dotted at its far end) to the top of a semicircular arc that bulges to the right; from the bottom of the arc a long straight wire goes vertically downward (dotted at its far end); a small dot at the arc centre with a short radius line; small arrowheads along the wires show the current direction. Recreate the figure of NTA's JEE (Main) 2026 paper, 2 April Shift 1, question 39 faithfully (same parts, positions and directions); every letter, number, sign and arrow label is added by the app at label anchors.
must_show: hairpin of two parallel straight wires joined by a semicircle
a straight wire into a semicircle that then continues vertically downward
dots at both arc centres with radius lines
must_not_show: a scan or copy of the original paper

alt.en: Shape I: two long parallel wires joined by a semicircle of radius r, carrying current I out and back, with centre P. Shape II: a long horizontal wire, a semicircle of radius r with centre Q, then a long wire going straight down from the end of the arc in line with Q.
alt.hi: आकृति I: त्रिज्या r के अर्धवृत्त से जुड़े दो लंबे समांतर तार, जिनमें धारा I जाती और लौटती है, केंद्र P। आकृति II: एक लंबा क्षैतिज तार, केंद्र Q वाला त्रिज्या r का अर्धवृत्त, फिर चाप के सिरे से Q की सीध में सीधा नीचे जाता लंबा तार।
